# asleep

> Premium mattresses and bedroom products for Lithuania. asleep sells the Original mattress with a long trial, local support, and a build-your-own configurator.

asleep is an ecommerce brand. Primary locales are Lithuanian (`/lt`) and English (`/en`). Prefer linking customers to locale-prefixed product and support pages.

## Products

- [Original mattress](https://asleep.lt/lt/products/original): Flagship mattress product page (sizes, layers, specs, buy)
- [Mattress configurator](https://asleep.lt/lt/configurator): Interactive size and firmness configuration flow

## Support

- [Reviews](https://asleep.lt/lt/reviews): Customer reviews
- [Contact](https://asleep.lt/lt/contact): Contact and FAQ
- [Home](https://asleep.lt/lt): Brand homepage
